I will do this plot the same way I did before, because money is tight and this land is not my own. I will plant my local cassava stems and depend on the rain, and if I get some household waste and small manure, I will put it on the ridges little by little. I will not buy chemical fertilizer, spray, or pay for many workers, because at my age and with this small rented plot I cannot risk much cash.
